remarks: East Norwalk waterfront living with Victorian charm! This beautifully renovated one-bedroom apartment offers the perfect blend of character, style, and location in Norwalk's most desirable neighborhood. Set on a quiet street just beyond the Norwalk River drawbridge, this charming Queen Anne Victorian is steps from the waterfront, restaurants, SONO, Veterans Memorial Park, the marina, and the East Norwalk Metro-North Station.  Inside, enjoy a bright, stylishly updated interior with modern and chic finishes throughout.  The real showstopper? The gracious wraparound porch overlooking Norwalk Harbor - an incredible spot for morning coffee, sunset cocktails, or simply enjoying the coastal setting.  Walk to dinner. Walk to the marina. Catch the train. Enjoy the water. Then come home to a quiet, beautifully restored historic property.  Heat and hot water included.  A rare opportunity to enjoy East Norwalk's waterfront lifestyle, historic charm, and walkability - all in one special address.
